policy.hosts: Smallest defensible display set. Prefer one primary owning region; non-owning material/source pressure goes in requiredRegions only.
exceptions: user-forced multi: Grace of the elves (GOTE), Death Ward dual, Area Tasks, fairy rings
UNOBTAINABLE multi-host displays (Blessed flask, Hatchet Ember/Bloom) — keep multi hosts so the unobtainable map stays visible
true dual content gates where both sides are unlock geography, not mere mats (kept only when defensible)

actions.primary: collapse hosts to one region; keep multi pressure in proposedReq
actions.tighten: reduce host count but still multi (rare)

decisions.name: All Fired Up → Inferno adze reward chain
decisions.reason: Owning display is the Asgarnia Inferno adze equipment/claim stack. Wilderness beacon geography is Forinthry material/route pressure only — keep in req, not a second host.

decisions.name: Area Tasks (achievement diaries) skilling overview
decisions.reason: Exception: each diary set is owned by its region. Multi-host is the product, not material pressure.

decisions.name: Artificer's measure
decisions.reason: Matches user ruling: single Anachronia display + multi-req UNOBTAINABLE tag. Other hosts are component pressure, not separate product homes.

decisions.name: Balarak's sash brush
decisions.reason: Finished tool is Orthen/Anachronia content; Forinthry is the journal/gate side of the same chain. Aggressive: one host, both still hard in req (user already forced both regions in pressure).

decisions.name: Blessed flask production chain
decisions.reason: Exception: UNOBTAINABLE multi-host display under 3-elective cap — keep the full map visible so planners see why it is unobtainable.

decisions.name: Bonecrusher auto-pickup upgrade (Waiko / Boni)
decisions.reason: Base bonecrusher / cleaner identity is Forinthry (Daemonheim). Boni/Waiko sink is purchase pressure taxonomized under Asgarnia — req only, not a second host.

decisions.name: Channeller's ring
decisions.reason: Anachronia owns the Rex heart (defining drop); Fremennik is base-ring feedstock pressure. Mirror reaver/stalker primary rule.

decisions.name: Conservation of Energy relic chain
decisions.reason: Relic powers surface at the Misthalin monolith path; Asgarnia/Kandarin dig artefacts are chain pressure, not separate product homes.

decisions.name: Crystal fishing rod + Prif waterfall + Fury shark stack
decisions.reason: Owning content is Prif crystal rod + waterfall. Kandarin fury-shark half is a separate stack (user already ignored that combo elsewhere); do not dual-host the crystal fishing package.

decisions.name: Death Ward relic chain
decisions.reason: Exception: user-forced dual — Stormguard dig (Kandarin) + Armadyl Tower turn-in (Asgarnia) are both content geography.

decisions.name: Edgeville skilling and Wilderness on-ramp hub
decisions.reason: Edgeville town is Misthalin-owned. Forinthry is Wilderness destination pressure north of the ditch, not a second hub host.

decisions.name: Elder divination outfit path (Cache base + Invention elite)
decisions.reason: Elite invention step is Asgarnia Guild geography; Cache/diviner base is Kandarin pressure. Prefer single display at Invention home (matches other elite-outfit collapses).

decisions.name: Elite skilling outfits core set (ironman fragment paths)
decisions.reason: Portfolio, not seven products. Prefer individual outfit rows for effects; one Asgarnia display carries fragment-path pressure in req. Prior user multi-host was scoring convenience, not seven homes.

decisions.name: Elite tectonic robe armour
decisions.reason: Asgarnia owns Vorago tectonic + Virtus/praesulic craft identity. Draconic energy / chaotic remnant are Forinthry material pressure only.

decisions.name: Expansive essence pouch (70 essence, non-degrading)
decisions.reason: Non-degrading expansive pouch is Daemonheim/Dungeoneering-facing storage. Misthalin was residual craft/footnote pressure — drop as host and as hard req unless a separate craft gate is proven.

decisions.name: Extreme invention supply combo (Guild + webbing + Herblore)
decisions.reason: Owning path is Invention Guild (Asgarnia). Anachronia webbing/herb supply is material pressure (POF can substitute).

decisions.name: Fairy ring network (Zanaris hub)
decisions.reason: Exception: user-forced multi travel package — Zanaris hub (Misthalin taxonomy) + Morytania ring geography stay dual.

decisions.name: Fury of the Small relic chain
decisions.reason: Warforge dig owns the artefact half (Kandarin); Misthalin is monolith/turn-in pressure. Prefer dig-site primary over dual host.

decisions.name: Grace of the elves (GOTE)
decisions.reason: Exception: explicit user ruling GOTE = Forinthry + Tirannwn. Dark Facet stays Forinthry-only separately.

decisions.name: Hatchet of Bloom and Blight
decisions.reason: Exception: UNOBTAINABLE multi-host t100 chain — keep full component map visible under elective cap.

decisions.name: Hatchet of Ember and Glade
decisions.reason: Exception: UNOBTAINABLE multi-host self-sufficient chain — do not collapse finished hatchet to one region display.

decisions.name: Hatchet progression checklist (dragon → Imcando → crystal → Ember and Glade → Bloom and Blight)
decisions.reason: Residual checklist over piece rows; piece equipment already carries region pressure. Drop to avoid multi-host noise.

decisions.name: Imcando tools family (pickaxe, hatchet, related craft pressure)
decisions.reason: Package row for scoring one Imcando tool — Camdozaal/Asgarnia is the natural family home. Misthalin/Fremennik stay hard chain pressure in req (crystal legs remain on finished t90 piece rows).

decisions.name: Masterwork plate → Orthen furnace core pressure stack
decisions.reason: Orthen core is Anachronia content. Masterwork plate + ore/smith inputs are material pressure (Asgarnia Artisans, Forinthry/Desert ore routes) — req only.

decisions.name: Masterwork ranged armour material pressure (Havenhythe/Anachronia Hunter)
decisions.reason: Support densify only. Havenhythe is free starting pressure; Anachronia BGH is elective — do not dual-host until recipe hard-locks it.

decisions.name: Masterwork Spear of Annihilation
decisions.reason: Artisans/masterwork home is Asgarnia; Morytania is essence/material pressure (same pattern as trimmed masterwork).

decisions.name: Mattock of Time and Space
decisions.reason: Crystal mattock / Tirannwn side owns the finished tool identity. Guildmaster shard (Misthalin), hammer/shop (Kandarin), dragon-mattock (Anachronia) are chain pressure.

decisions.name: Mattock progression checklist (dragon → crystal / Imcando → MoTaS → Tony)
decisions.reason: Residual checklist over piece rows; remove multi-host noise.

decisions.name: Orthen furnace core + Superheat Form + smithing autoheater stack
decisions.reason: Furnace core item is Anachronia. Superheat Form (Tirannwn) and autoheater (Forinthry) are stack pressure, not co-homes of the core.

decisions.name: Orthen furnace core full skilling stack
decisions.reason: Companion stack to anachronia:orthen-furnace-core. Display once on Anachronia; keep Tirannwn+Forinthry as sustained-AFK pressure in req.

decisions.name: Perfect juju potion production path
decisions.reason: Juju production hub is Karamja. Crystal flasks/blossoms are Tirannwn material pressure.

decisions.name: Pickaxe of Earth and Song
decisions.reason: Finished crystal pick side is Tirannwn; Imcando/Fremennik is hard feedstock. Kandarin blast-fusion/forge is craft-site pressure only — drop from hard hosts/req (detail already warned not to hard-require Kandarin).

decisions.name: Pickaxe of Life and Death
decisions.reason: t100 continuation identity leans Camdozaal/Asgarnia progression; Fremennik+Tirannwn remain Earth-and-Song chain pressure in req.

decisions.name: Pickaxe progression checklist (dragon → Imcando → crystal → Earth and Song → Life and Death)
decisions.reason: Residual checklist over piece rows; remove multi-host noise.

decisions.name: Player-owned house portal towns and Construction utilities
decisions.reason: House instance is not region-owned; Rimmington (Asgarnia) is the preferred Construction loop. Portal exits are convenience geography, not seven hard hosts or multi-req locks.

decisions.name: POH gilded altar (Chapel offering)
decisions.reason: POH gilded is house-facing (default Misthalin display). Marble/limestone/burner materials and Fort comparison pressure stay in req without multi-hosting every supply region.

decisions.name: Reaver's ring
decisions.reason: Anachronia owns the heart drop; Fremennik owns ring feedstock — pressure only.

decisions.name: Ring of slaying (craft unlock)
decisions.reason: Matches user ruling: craft unlock is global points QoL. Teleport destinations are not hard region hosts/req.

decisions.name: Sirenic → elite sirenic armour
decisions.reason: Scale-farm identity is Forinthry-leaning; detail already forbids hard multi-required electives. Tirannwn/lab materials stay hints, not second host or hard req.

decisions.name: Sirenic armour (T90 ranged power craft)
decisions.reason: Intentionally multi-source scales — show as Forinthry support pressure, not fake dual-host lock. Morytania is optional scale geography, not co-home.

decisions.name: Skeka's hypnowand
decisions.reason: Pieces/content resolve on Anachronia; Daemonheim journal gate is real Forinthry pressure kept hard in req, not a second display host.

decisions.name: Slayer helmet (craft unlock + base helm)
decisions.reason: Black-mask farm owns the base helm path (Morytania). Point sink is global — Misthalin is not a second home.

decisions.name: Slayer helmet component farms
decisions.reason: Planner hub for style coverage: primary display on black-mask home; other component farms are regional pressure in req. Misthalin shop pieces are not region-locked hosts.

decisions.name: Slayer Introspection (Amascut's Enchanted Gem)
decisions.reason: True multi-region archaeology collection (Knowledge is Power route). Each listed region owns a piece of the collection path — not mere mats. Keep multi (user already forced three-host).

decisions.name: Stalker's ring
decisions.reason: Mirror reaver/channeller: Anachronia heart owns display; Fremennik ring feedstock is pressure.

decisions.name: Trimmed / custom-fit trimmed masterwork melee armour
decisions.reason: Artisans custom-fit + Torva/praesulic home is Asgarnia. Malevolent essence is Morytania material pressure — hard in req, not dual host.
